title: Loved With an Everlasting Love
traveler_why: Willow is the gentle Traveler, and tonight Heavenly Father is gentle with people who felt forgotten: He draws His people close with lovingkindness the way Willow scoots over slowly and shares her crayons, inviting and never pushing.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she is gentle, and this story shows Heavenly Father being gentle with people who felt forgotten. In Willow’s world today: a new boy sits alone at the edge of the preschool rug. Willow does not tug his arm. She scoots over slowly and shares half her crayons until he scoots closer. Just like Heavenly Father drawing His people close with lovingkindness, Willow learned that real love invites and never pushes.
